messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident fired for service=redwood-inference-az2-serving severity=high — symptom: sudden request errors (502/504) and pod evictions in az2. Pager: @mike, @anya, on-call policy: persistent.
pagerduty-bot: Incident  INC-2026-1842 created. Incident URL: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026-1842 — triggered by k8s eviction alerts and increased 5xx rate.
mike: acked on PagerDuty. joining. seeing spike in evictions on az2 nodes: kubelet OOM/kubelet eviction thresholds hit. :sweat:
anya: i'm pulling k8s events + node metrics. asking @leo to check infra metrics for instance health and disk pressure.
leo: looking now — cluster autoscaler did not scale up, preemptible pool had multiple terminations. Cloud reports underlying host reclamations in az2-3. Initiating temp capacity reserve in az2-secondary.
devon: any customer impact yet? any routes failing over?
mike: yes, about 8% of production requests routed to az2 are failing with 502s, affecting some low-latency customers (chat endpoints). gradable impact: partial service degradation.
anya: starting mitigation: 1) mark az2 nodes as scheduling-disabled except for emergency pods; 2) enable failover routing to az1 and az3 for traffic. I'll post commands.
anya: Command to cordon nodes:
```bash
kubectl get nodes -l topology.kubernetes.io/zone=az2 -o name | xargs -r kubectl cordon
```
anya: Enable routing failover (on control plane):
```text
set routing.policy.region_preference["us-east-az2"] = { weight: 0.1, fallback: ["us-east-az1","us-east-az3"] }
apply routing.policy
```
mike: i'm going to bump the model-serving pool in az3 to soak extra traffic: scaling dedicated pool + increasing concurrency target. Command:
```bash
redwoodctl pool scale --pool model-serving-az3 --replicas 12
```
leo: started spin-up of replacement instances in az2 to stabilize node churn (non-preemptible). cloud API shows 4 new instances provisioning. ETA ~3m.
pagerduty-bot: Escalation: if not acknowledged by infra lead in 5m escalate to on-call director.
infra-oncall: i'm on call and watching metrics. suggest enabling KV-cache bypass fallback for affected routes to reduce memory pressure: flip flag.
anya: toggling cache bypass for vulnerable endpoints now:
```json
{"service":"chat","kv_cache_bypass":true,"rollout":"canary"}
```
anja: (typo) — meant to say "anya". :facepalm:
leo: new instances in az2 are up; kubelet reconnects in logs show reduced eviction events. node conditions: DiskPressure cleared on 3/4 nodes.
mike: traffic now shifting — 90% of az2 traffic has been routed to az1/az3. 5xx rate trending down to baseline. customer impact decreased to ~1% failing requests.
devon: communicating to CS: drafting status note — impacted customers mainly on low-latency chat tier; trying to estimate number of orgs. will post update to #customer-notify in 10m.
anya: handoff: @mike will stay on mitigation for next 30m then hand over to @infra-oncall for monitoring and postmortem. Please ack handoff.
mike: ack. will produce timeline + initial blameless notes.
infra-oncall: acknowledged handoff. I'll monitor for 1 hour. please collect logs for pod evictions and scheduler decisions and share manifest snapshots.
mike: saving k8s events + scheduler logs, uploading to incident folder: /incidents/INC-2026-1842/artifacts. Also saving sample request traces for affected customers.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-1842: status=mitigated (failover applied, node replacements provisioning). Keep open for postmortem data collection. :white_check_mark:
devon: CS update posted. customers notified: "Partial degradation isolated to az2; failover active; mitigation in progress. We'll post follow-ups and RCA." :email:
anya: action items captured: 1) postmortem with timeline + root cause (host reclamation + autoscaler/misconfig), 2) revisit autoscaler thresholds for preemptible pools, 3) add graceful draining runbook for model-serving pods, 4) verify routing fallback SLO test. Assigning to @mike, @leo, @infra-oncall.
mike: adding to board and will kick off RCA doc. thanks all — closing active page once logs collected and monitoring stable for 30m. :thumbsup:
